author: South Raleigh News
title: Pitt County Republican Convention set for March 8
text:
Gary Weaver Chairman | Pitt County GOP
Gary Weaver Chairman | Pitt County GOP
The Pitt County Republican Convention is scheduled for Saturday, March 8, 2025. The event will take place in Room 153 of the Fulford Building on the PCC Campus. Registration begins at noon, with the convention starting at 1 PM.
Attendees interested in becoming Delegates or Alternates to vote at District and State Conventions must be certified during this County Convention. To qualify, individuals need to have been registered as Republicans in Pitt County by January 31, 2025. There is a registration fee of $10.
The convention aims to unite participants in support of conservative values and to promote a strong Republican future within Pitt County.
"Paid for by the Pitt County Republican Party."
